purpose: Close concrete file-identity and dependency gaps for two existing candidates instead of adding another broad candidate search.

blocking_before_acquisition: Check whether the exact pinned base files already exist and match hashes; do not count shared bytes as free space before verification.
Confirm full learned component census including encoder, VAE and LoRA; transformer-only Hub count is not pipeline total.
Finalize runtime/dependency environment for intended hardware and review custom inference code without executing it.
Confirm actual disk identity/free space/staging and approve a final immutable manifest; this is a candidate, not a lock.
Pin the validated llama.cpp/runtime build and record user memory/context limits; no local speed or full pipeline peak measured.
Verify files at transfer time against pinned identities; HTTP 200 metadata is not successful payload transfer.
Record complete conversion/component census if required by final parameter gate; source total does not prove tensor identity of a conversion.
Confirm physical disk/free space/staging and explicit final-manifest approval; do not re-use existing empty approved queue implicitly.

regulatory_evidence: No newly verified removal notice or upcoming legal ban for either selected package. Priority is a preservation scenario and distinctiveness judgment, not a measured restriction probability.
stop_condition: File plans closed at source-metadata level; do not reopen broad discovery until source/runtime/count/storage blockers for these packages are addressed.
